value.headline: We help local governments create and run data-driven programs that protect tenants, increase housing supply, preserve affordability, and revitalize neighborhoods.
value.subheadline: From property registration to affordable housing, Tolemi delivers the data, the workflows, and the hands-on support to take a housing program from idea to impact.

value.heading: From Data to Action
value.subheading: Housing programs run on connected data. Tolemi turns the records your city already has into insights, workflows, and results on the ground.

stages.label: Data
stages.detail: Property, sales, assessment, code violations, 311 service calls, rental records — connected across every department.

stages.label: Insights
stages.detail: Owner timelines, linked portfolios, likely rentals, and risk indicators derived automatically.

stages.label: Workflows
stages.detail: Registration portals, inspections, outreach campaigns, payment collection, and compliance tracking.

stages.label: Action
stages.detail: Programs launched, violations resolved, and safer housing in your community.

value.heading: One Platform, Three Layers
value.subheading: Cities don't need another application — they need a program that works. Our products are how we deliver it.

items.name: Slate
items.description: Slate runs your housing programs end to end — long-term and short-term rental registration, affordable housing initiatives, and land bank programs. It manages the whole lifecycle: registration portals, inspections, email and mail outreach, payment collection, and compliance tracking.
bullets: Registration and licensing portal with online payments

items.name: BuildingBlocks
items.description: BuildingBlocks connects the data your city already has — property, sales, assessment, code violations, 311 service calls — and keeps it current. It links owners across LLCs, builds ownership timelines, and surfaces likely rentals, so your programs start from the full picture.
bullets: Integrates data across departments and formats
Links owners and entities into full portfolios
Surfaces likely rentals and risk indicators
items.imageAlt: BuildingBlocks map view of connected city property data

items.name: PubliCity
items.description: PubliCity gives residents a simple public portal to look up properties, view active development projects, and engage with your programs. We configure and customize it so the public sees exactly what you want them to see.
bullets: Configured and branded for your city
items.imageAlt: PubliCity public portal for property lookup

value.heading: Your property registry, empowered by your data
value.body: Most registries wait for owners to come forward. Tolemi's registry already knows your city — who owns what, what's likely a rental, and where the problems are. It's why most of our new city partnerships start here.

bullets.title: Owner linking
bullets.description: An owner can't register five buildings that pass and quietly skip the two that don't. Linked ownership reveals the whole portfolio.

bullets.title: Find every rental
bullets.description: Likely rentals that never registered are flagged automatically — your registry sees more than the owners who opt in.

bullets.title: Risk-based inspections
bullets.description: Problem properties get attention constantly; responsible owners aren't over-burdened. Inspector time goes where it matters.

value.heading: Turnkey, From First Meeting to Full Compliance
value.subheading: We do much more than provide tools. We stand up the program with you, and provide ongoing support while you run it.

steps.title: Understand

steps.title: Connect your data
steps.description: We integrate your systems, hydrate them with external datasets, and connect the dots into usable insights.

steps.title: Stand up the program

steps.title: Measure and improve

steps.title: Support, always

value.closing: We hold your hand throughout the whole program lifecycle.

value.heading: Not Another Generic Software Vendor
value.body: We are a team of citizens who care: technologists, activists, and former municipal staff who have been doing this work for over ten years. We learned it the hard way, alongside our partners in more than 100 cities, states, and land banks. We bring that network's experience, best practices, and pitfalls to avoid to every new program.

points.title: 10+ years
points.description: working with local government data and housing programs.

points.title: 100+ municipal partners

points.title: We've sat in your seat
points.description: Some of us worked at municipalities. We build for the people doing the work.
